articles.title: Purple swirls on the Red Planet
articles.summary: This image shows a prominent ice cliff near Mars’s south pole. With striking swirls of purple, pink and red, it’s a far cry from the colour palette we usually associate with the Red Planet.

articles.title: Open Cosmos Raises €300 Million as Investors Back Europe’s Space Push
articles.summary:
UK-based satellite maker Open Cosmos announced on 14 September that it had closed a €300 million funding round. The company said it would use the new funding to expand its manufacturing capacity and accelerate the deployment of its Earth observation and communications constellations.
